text.body: <1> nityānandaikarasaṃ saccinmātraṃ svayañjyotiḥ | puruṣottamamajamīśaṃ vande śrīyādavādhīśam || 1|| yaṃ varṇayituṃ sākṣācchṛtirapi mūkeva maunamācarati | so'smākaṃ manujānāṃ kiṃ vācāṃ gocaro bhavati || 2|| yadyapyevaṃ viditaṃ tathāpi paribhāṣito bhavedeva | adhyātmaśāstrasārairharicintanakīrtanābhyāsaiḥ || 3|| klṛptairbahubhirupāyairabhyāsajñānabhaktyādyaiḥ | puṃso vinā virāgaṃ mukteradhikāritā na syāt || 4|| vairāgyamātmabodho bhaktiśceti trayaṃ gaditam | mukteḥ sādhanamādau tatra virāgo vitṛṣṇatā proktā || 5|| sā cāhaṃmamatābhyāṃ pracchannā sarvadeheṣu | tatrāhantā dehe mamatā bhāryādiviṣayeṣu || 6|| dehaḥ kimātmako'yaṃ kaḥ sambandho'sya vā viṣayaiḥ | evaṃ vicāryamāṇe'hantāmamate nivartete || 7|| strīpuṃsoḥ saṃyogātsampāte śukraśoṇitayoḥ | praviśañjīvaḥ śanakaiḥ svakarmaṇā dehamādhatte || 8|| mātṛgurūdaradaryāṃ kaphamūtrapurīṣapūrṇāyām | jaṭharāgnijvālābhirnavamāsaṃ pacyate jantuḥ || 9|| daivātprasūtisamaye śiśustiraścīnatāṃ yadā yāti | śastrairvikhaṇḍya sa tadā bahiriha niṣkāsyate'tibalāt || 10|| athavā yantracchidrādyada tu niḥsāryate prabalaiḥ | prasavasamīraiśca tadā yaḥ kleśaḥ so'pyanirvācyaḥ || 11|| ādhivyādhiviyogātmīyavipatkalahadīrghadāridraiḥ | janmāntaramapi yaḥ kleśaḥ kiṃ śakyate vaktum || 12|| narapaśuvihaṅgatiryagyonīnāṃ caturaśītilakṣāṇām | karmanibaddho jīvaḥ paribhramanyātanā bhuṅkte || 13|| caramastatra nṛdehastatrojjanmānvayotpattiḥ | svakulācāravicāraḥ śrutipracāraśca tatrāpi || 14|| ātmānātmaviveko no dehasya ca vināśitājñānam | evaṃ sati svamāyuḥ prājñairapi nīyate mithyā || 15|| āyuḥkṣaṇalavamātraṃ na labhyate hemakoṭibhiḥ kvāpi | taccedgacchati sarvaṃ mṛṣā tataḥ kādhikā hāniḥ || 16|| naradehātikramaṇātprāptau paśvādidehānām | svatanorapyajñāne paramārthasyātra kā vārtā || 17|| satataṃ pravāhyamānairvṛṣabhairaśvaiḥ kharairgajairmahiṣaiḥ | hā kaṣṭaṃ kṣutkāmaiḥ śrāntairno śakyate vaktum || 18|| rudhiratridhātumajjāmedomāṃsāsthisaṃhatirdehaḥ | sa bahistvacā pinaddhastasmānno bhakṣyate kākaiḥ || 19|| nāsāgrādvadanādavā kaphaṃ malaṃ pāyuto visṛjan | svayamevaiti jugupsāmantaḥ prasṛtaṃ ca no vetti || 20|| pathi patitamasthi dṛṣṭvā sparśabhayādanyamārgato yāti | no paśyati nijadehaṃ cāsthisahasrāvṛtaṃ paritaḥ || 21|| keśāvadhi nakharāgrādidamantaḥ pūtigandhasampūrṇam | bahirapi cāgarucandanakarpūrādyairvilepayati || 22|| yatnādasya pidhatte svābhāvikadoṣasaṅghātam | aupādhikaguṇanivahaṃ prakāśayañślāghate mūḍhaḥ || 23|| kṣatamutannaṃ dehe yadi na prakṣālyate tridinam | tatrotpatanti bahavaḥ krimayo durgandhasaṅkīrṇāḥ || 24|| yo dehaḥ supto'bhūtsupuṣpaśayyopaśobhite talpe | samprati sa rajjukāṣṭhairniyantritaḥ kṣipyate vahnau || 25|| siṃhāsanopaviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaṃ mudamavāpa loko'yam | taṃ kālākṛṣṭatanuṃ vilokya netre nimīlayati || 26|| evaṃvidho'timalino deho yatsattayā calati | taṃ vismṛtya pareśaṃ vahatyahantāmanitye'smin || 27|| kvātmā saccidrūpaḥ kva māṃsarudhirāsthinirmito dehaḥ | iti yo lajjati dhīmānitaraśarīraṃ sa kiṃ manute || 28|| <2> mūḍhaḥ kurute viṣayajakardamasaṃmārjanaṃ mithyā | duradṛṣṭavṛṣṭiviraso deho gehaṃ patatyeva || 29|| bhāryā rūpavihīnā manasaḥ kṣobhāya jāyate puṃsām | atyantaṃ rūpāḍhyā sā parapuruṣairvaśīkriyate || 30|| yaḥ kaścitparapuruṣo mtraṃ bhṛtyo'thavā bhikṣuḥ | paśyati hi sābhilāṣaṃ vilakṣaṇodārarūpavatīm ||31|| yaṃ kañcitpuruṣavaraṃ svabharturatisundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā | mṛgayati kiṃ na mṛgākṣī manaseva parastriyaṃ puruṣaḥ || 32|| evaṃ surūpanāryā bhartā kopātpratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīṇaḥ | no labhate sukhaleśaṃ balimiva balibhugbahuṣvekaḥ || 33|| vanitā nitāntamajñā svājñāmullaṅghya vartate yadi sā | śatrorapyadhikatarā parabhilāṣiṇyasau kimuta || 34|| loko nāputrasyāstīti śrutyāsya kaḥ prabhāṣito lokaḥ | muktiḥ saṃsaraṇaṃ vā tadanyaloko'thavā nādyaḥ || 35|| sarve'pi putrabhājastanmuktau saṃsṛtirbhavati | śravaṇādayo'pyupāyā mṛṣā bhaveyustṛtīye'pi || 36|| tatprāptyupāyasattvāddvitīyapakṣe'pyaputrasya | putreṣṭyādikayāgapravṛttaye vedavādo'yam || 37|| nānāśarīrakaṣṭairdhanavyayaiḥ sādhyate putraḥ | utpannamātraputre jīvitacintā garīyasī tasya || 38|| jīvannapi kiṃ mūrkhaḥ prājñaḥ kiṃ vā suśīlabhāgbhavitā | jāraścauraḥ piśunaḥ patito dyūtapriyaḥ krūraḥ || 39|| pitṛmātṛbandhughātī manasaḥ khedāya jāyate putraḥ | cintayati tātanidhanaṃ putro dravyādyadhīśatāhetoḥ || 40|| sarvaguṇairupapannaḥ putraḥ kasyāpi kutracidbhavati | so'lpāyū rugṇo vā hyanapatyo vā tathāpi khedāya || 41|| putrātsadgatiriti cettadapi prāyo'sti yuktyasaham | itthaṃ śarīrakaṣṭairduḥkhaṃ samprārthyate mūḍhaiḥ || 42|| pitṛmātṛbandhubhaginīpitṛvyajāmātṛmukhyānām | mārgasthānāmiva yutiranekayonibhramātkṣaṇikā || 43|| daivaṃ yāvadvipulaṃ yāvatpracuraḥ paropakāraśca | tāvatsarve suhṛdo vyatyayataḥ śatravaḥ sarve || 44|| aśnanti cedanudinaṃ vandina iva varṇayanti santṛptāḥ | tacceddvitradināntaramabhinindantaḥ prakupyanti || 45|| durbharajaṭharanimittaṃ samupārjayituṃ pravartate cittam | lakṣāvadhi bahuvittaṃ tathāpyalabhyaṃ kapardikāmātram || 46|| labdhaścedadhiko'rthaḥ patnyādīnāṃ bhavetsvārthaḥ | nṛpacaurato'pyanarthastasmādṛvyodyamo vyarthaḥ || 47|| anyāyamarthabhājaṃ paśyati bhūpo'dhvagāminaṃ cauraḥ | piśuno vyasanaprāptiṃ dāyādānāṃ gaṇaḥ kalaham || 48|| pātakabharairanekairarthaṃ samupārjayanti rājānaḥ | aśvamataṅgajahetoḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśyate so'rthaḥ || 49|| rājyāntarābhigamanādraṇabhaṅgānmantribhṛtyadoṣādvā | viṣaśastraguptaghātānmagnāścintārṇave bhūpāḥ || 50|| <3> hasati kadācidrauti bhrāntaṃ saddaśa diśo bhramati | hṛṣṭaṃ kadāpi ruṣṭaṃ śiṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca nindati stauti || 51|| kimapi dveṣṭi saroṣaṃ hyātmānaṃ ślāghate kadācidapi | cittaṃ piśācamabhavadrākṣasyā tṛṣṇayā vyāptam || 52|| dambhābhimānalobhaiḥ kāmakrodhorumatsaraiścetaḥ | ākṛṣyate samantācchvabhiriva patitāsthivanmārge || 53|| tasmācchuddhavirāgo mano'bhilaṣitaṃ tyajedartham | tadanabhilaṣitaṃ kuryānnirvyāpāraṃ tato bhavati || 54|| <4> saṃsṛtipārāvāre hyagādhaviṣayodakena sampūrṇe | nṛśarīramambutaraṇaṃ karmasamīrairatastataścalati || 55|| chidrairnavabhirupetaṃ jīvo naukāpatirmahānalasaḥ | chidrāṇāmanirodhājjalaparipūrṇa patatyadhaḥ satatam || 56|| chidrāṇāṃ tu nirodhātsukhena pāraṃ paraṃ yāti | tasmādindriyanigrahamṛte na kaścittaratyanṛtam || 57|| paśyati parasya yuvati sakāmamapi tanmanorathaṃ kurute | jñātvaiva tadaprāptiṃ vyarthaṃ manujo'tipāpabhāgbhavati || 58|| piśunaiḥ prakāmamuditāṃ parasya nindāṃ śruṇoti karṇābhyām | tena paraḥ kiṃ mriyate vyarthaṃ manujo'tipāpabhāgbhavati || 59|| anṛtaṃ parāpavādaṃ rasanā vadati pratikṣaṇaṃ tena | parahānirlabdhiḥ kā vyarthaṃ manujo'tipāpabhāgbhavati || 60|| viṣayendriyayoryoge nimepasamayena yatsukhaṃ bhavati | viṣaye naṣṭe duḥkhaṃ yāvajjivaṃ ca tattayormadhye || 61|| heyamupādeyaṃ vā pravicārya suniścitaṃ tasmāt | alpasukhasya tyāgādanalpaduḥkhaṃ jahāti sudhīḥ || 62|| dhīvaradattamahāmiṣamaśnanvaisāriṇo mriyate | tadvadviṣayānbhuñjankalākṛṣṭo naraḥ patati ||63|| uragagrastārdhatanurbheko'śnātīha makṣikāḥ śataśaḥ | evaṃ gatāyurapi sanviṣayānsamupāryatyandhaḥ || 64|| <5> svīyodgamatoyavahā sāgaramupayāti nīcamārgeṇa | sā cedudgama eva sthirā satī kiṃ na yāti vārdhitvam || 65|| evaṃ manaḥ svahetuṃ vicārayatsusthiraṃ bhavedantaḥ | na bahirvodeti tadā kiṃ nātmatvaṃ svayaṃ yāti || 66|| varṣāsvambhaḥpracayātkūpe gurunirjhare payaḥ kṣāram | grīṣmeṇaiva tu śuṣke mādhuryaṃ bhajati tatrāmbhaḥ || 67|| tadvadviṣayodriktaṃ tamaḥpradhānaṃ manaḥ kaluṣam | tasminvirāgaśuṣke śanakairāvirbhavetsattvam || 68|| yaṃ viṣayamapi laṣitvā dhāvati bāhyendriyadvārā | tasyāprāptau khidyati tathā yathā svaṃ gataṃ kiñcit || 69|| naganagaradurgadurgamasaritaḥ paritaḥ paribhramaccetaḥ | yadi no labhate viṣayaṃ viṣayantritamiva khinnamāyāti || 70|| tumbīphlaṃ jalāntarbalādadhaḥ kṣiptamapyupaityūrdhvam | tadvanmanaḥ svarūpe nihitaṃ yatnādbahiryāti || 71|| iha vā pūrvabhave vā svakarmaṇaivārjitaṃ phalaṃ yadyat | śubhamaśubhaṃ vā tattadbhogo'pyaprārthito bhavati || 72|| cetaḥpaśumaśubhapathaṃ pradhāvamānaṃ nirākartum | vairāgyamekamucitaṃ galakāṣṭhaṃ nirmitaṃ dhātrā || 73|| nidrāvasare yatsukhametatkiṃ viṣayajaṃ yasmāt | na hi cendriyapradeśāvasthānaṃ cetaso nidrā || 74|| advāratuṅgakuḍye gṛhe'varuddho yathā vyāghraḥ | bahunirgamaprayatnaiḥ śrāntastiṣṭhati patañśvasaṃśca tathā || 75|| sarvendriyāvarodhādudyogaśatairanirgamaṃ vīkṣya | śāntaṃ tiṣṭhati ceto nirudyamatvaṃ tadā yāti || 76|| prāṇaspandanirodhātsatsaṅgādvāsanātyāgāt | haricaraṇabhaktiyogānmanaḥ svavegaṃ jahāti śanaiḥ || 77|| <6> paragṛhagṛhiṇīputradraviṇānāmāgame vināśe vā | kathitau harṣaviṣādau kiṃ vā syātāṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthātuḥ || 78|| daivātsthitaṃ gataṃ vā yaṃ kañcidviṣayamīḍyamalpaṃ vā | no tuṣyanna ca sīdanvīkṣya gṛheṣvatithivannivaset || 79|| mamatābhimānaśūnyo viṣayeṣu parāṅmukhaḥ puruṣaḥ | tiṣṭhannapi nijasadane na bādhyate karmabhiḥ kvāpi || 80|| kutrāpyaraṇyadeśe sunīlatṛṇavālikopacite | śītalatarutalabhūmau sukhaṃ śayānasya puruṣasya || 81|| taravaḥ patraphalāḍhyāḥ sugandhaśītānilāḥ paritaḥ | kalakūjitavaravihagāḥ sarito mitrāṇi kiṃ na syuḥ || 82|| vairāgyabhāgyabhājaḥ prasannamanaso nirāśasya | aprārthitaphalabhoktuḥ puṃso janmani kṛtārthateha syāt || 83|| dravyaṃ pallavataścyutaṃ yadi bhavetkvāpi pramādāttadā śokāyātha tadarpitaṃ śrutavate toṣāya ca śreyase | svātantryādviṣayāḥ prayānti yadamī śokāya te syuściraṃ santyaktāḥ svayameva cetsukhamayaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ tanvate || 84|| vismṛtyātmanivāsamutkaṭabhavāṭavyāṃ ciraṃ paryaṭansantāpatrayadīrghadāvadahanajvālāvalīvyākulaḥ | valganphalguṣu supradīptanayanaścetaḥkuraṅgo balādāśāpāśavaśīkṛto'pi viṣayavyāghrairmṛṣā hanyate || 85|| <7> utpanne'pi virāge vinā prabodhaṃ sukhaṃ na syāt | sa bhavedgurūpadeśāttasmādgurumāśrayetprathamam || 86|| yadyapi jaladherudakaṃ yadyapi vā prerako'nilastatra | tadapi pipāsākulitaḥ pratīkṣate cātako megham || 87|| tredhā pratītiruktā śāstrādgurutastathātmanastatra | śāstrapratītirādau yadvanmadhuro guḍo'stīti || 88|| agre gurupratītirdūrādguḍadarśanaṃ yadvat | ātmapratītirasmādguḍabhakṣaṇajaṃ sukhaṃ yadvat || 89|| rasagandharūpaśabdasparśā anye padārthāśca | kasmādanubhūyante no dehānnendriyagrāmāt || 90|| mṛtadehendriyavargo yato na jānāti dāhajaṃ duḥkham | prāṇaścennidrāyāṃ taskarabādhāṃ sa kiṃ vetti || 91|| manaso yadi vā viṣayastadyugapatkiṃ na jānāti | tasya parādhīnatvādyataḥ pramādasya kastrātā || 92|| gāḍhadhvāntagṛhāntataḥ kṣititale dīpaṃ nidhāyojjvalaṃ pañcacchidramadhomukhaṃ hi kalaśaṃ tasyopari sthāpayet | tadbāhye parito'nurandhramamalāṃ vīṇāṃ ca kastūrikāṃ sadratnaṃ vyajanaṃ nyasecca kalaśacchidrādhvanirgacchatām || 93|| tejoṃśena pṛthakpadārthanivahajñānaṃ hi yajjāyate tadrandhraiḥ kalaśena vā kimu mṛdo bhāṇḍena tailena vā | kiṃ sūtreṇa na caitadasti ruciraṃ pratyakṣabādhādato dīpajyotirihaikameva śaraṇaṃ dehe tathātmā sthitaḥ || 94|| <8> cinmatraḥ paramātmā hyapaśyadātmānamātmatayā | abhavatso'haṃnāmā tasmādāsīdbhido mūlam || 95|| dvedhaiva bhāti tasmātpatiśca patnī ca tau bhavetāṃ vai | tasmādayamākāśastridhaiva paripūryate satatam || 96|| so'yamapīkṣāṃ cakre tato manuṣyā ajāyanta | ityupaniṣadaḥ prāhurdayitāṃ prati yājñavalkyoktyā || 97|| ciramānandānubhavātsuṣuptiriva kāpyavasthābhūt | paramātmanastu tasmātsvapnavadevotthitā māyā || 98|| sadasadvilakṣaṇāsau paramātmasadāśrayānādiḥ | sā ca guṇatrayarūpā sūte sacarācaraṃ viśvam || 99|| māyā tāvadadṛśyā dṛśyaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ janayet | tantubhiradṛśyarūpaiḥ paṭo'tra dṛśyaḥ kathaṃ bhavati || 100|| svapne suratānubhavācchukradrāvoyathā śubhe vasane | anṛtaṃ rataṃ prabodhe vasanopahatirbhavetsatyā || 101|| svapne puruṣaḥ satyo yoṣidasatyā tayoryutiśca mṛṣā | śukradrāvaḥ satyastadvatprakṛte'pi sambhavati || 102|| evamadṛśyā māyā tatkāryaṃ jagadidaṃ dṛśyam | māyā tāvadiyaṃ syādyā svavināśena harṣadā bhavati || 103|| rajanīvātidurantā na lakṣyate'tra svabhavo'syāḥ | saudāminīva naśyati munibhiḥ samprakṣyamāṇaiva || 104|| māyā brahmopagatāvidyā jīvāśrayā proktā | cidaścidgranthiścetastadakṣayaṃ jñeyamā mokṣāt || 105|| ghaṭamaṭhakuḍyairāvṛtamākāśaṃ tattadāhvayaṃ bhavati | tadvadavidyāvṛtamiha caitanyaṃ jīva ityuktaḥ || 106|| nanu kathamāvaraṇaṃ syādajñānaṃ brahmaṇo viśuddhasya | sūryasyeva tamisraṃ rātribhavaṃ svaprakāśasya || 107|| dinakarakiraṇotpannairmeghairācchādyate yathā sūryaḥ | na khalu dinasya dinatvaṃ tairvikṛtaiḥ sāndrasaṅghātaiḥ || 108|| ajñānena tathātmā śuddho'pi cchādyate suciram | na parantu lokasiddhā prāṇiṣu taccetanāśaktiḥ || 109|| <9> sthūlaśarīrasyāntarliṅgaśarīraṃ ca tasyāntaḥ | kāraṇamasyāpyantastato mahākāraṇaṃ turyam || 110|| sthūlaṃ nirūpitaṃ prāgadhunā sūkṣmādito brūmaḥ | aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ śrutiriti yatprāha tatsūkṣmam || 111|| sūkṣmāṇi mahābhūtānyasavaḥ pañcendriyāṇi pañcaiva | ṣoḍaṣamantaḥkaraṇaṃ tatsaṅghāto hi liṅgatanuḥ || 112|| tatkāraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ yattasyāntarvāsanājālam | tasya pravṛttiheturbuddhyāśrayamatra turyaṃ syāt || 113|| tatsārabhūtabuddho yatpratiphalitaṃ tu śuddhacaitanyam | jīvaḥ sa ukta ādyairyo'hamiti sphūrtikṛdvapuṣi || 114|| caratarataraṅgasaṅgātpratibimbaṃ bhāskarasya ca calaṃ syāt | asti tathā cañcalatā caitanye cittacāñcalyāt || 115|| nanvarkapratibimbaḥ salilādiṣuyaḥ sa cāvabhāsayati | kimitarapadārthanivahaṃ pratibimbo'pyātmanastadvat || 116|| pratiphalitaṃ yattejaḥ savituḥ kāṃsyādipātreṣu | tadanu praviṣṭamantargṛhamanyārthānprakāśayati || 117|| citpratibimbastadvadbuddhiṣu yo jīvatāṃ prāptaḥ | netrādīndriyamārgairbahirarthānso'vabhāsayati || 118|| <10> tadidaṃ ya evamāryo veda brahmāhamasmīti | sa idaṃ sarvaṃ ca syāttasya hi devāśca neśate bhūtyā || 119|| yeṣāṃ sa bhavatyātmā yo'nyāmatha devatāmupāste yaḥ | ahamanyo'sāvanyaścetthaṃ yo veda paśuvatsaḥ || 120|| ityupaniṣadāmuktistathā śrutirbhagavaduktiśca | jñānī tvātmaiveyaṃ matirmametyatra yuktirapi || 121|| ṛju vakraṃ vā kāṣṭhaṃ hutāśadagdhaṃ sadagnitāṃ yāti | tatkiṃ hastagrāhyaṃ ṛjuvakrākārasattve'pi || 122|| evaṃ ya ātmaniṣṭho hyātmākāraśca jāyate puruṣaḥ | dehīva dṛśyate'sau paraṃ tvasau kevalo hyātmā || 123|| pratiphalati bhānureko'nekaśarāvodakeṣu yathā | tadvadasau paramātmā hyeko'nekeṣu deheṣu || 124|| daivādekaśarāve bhagne kiṃ vā vilīyate sūryaḥ | pratibimbacañcalatvādarkaḥ kiṃ cañcalo bhavati || 125|| svavyāpāraṃ kurute yathaikasavituḥ prakāśena | tadvaccarācaramidaṃ hyekātmasattayā calati || 126|| yenodakena kadalīcampakajātyādayaḥ pravardhante | mūlakapalāṇḍulaśunāstenaivaite vibhinnarasagandhāḥ || 127|| eko hi sūtradhāraḥ kāṣṭhaprakṛtīranekaśo yugapat | stambhāgrapaṭṭikāyāṃ nartayatīha pragūḍhatayā || 128|| guḍakhaṇḍaśarkarādyā bhinnāḥ syurvikṛtayo yathaikekṣoḥ | keyūrakaṅkaṇādyā yathaikahemno bhidāśca pṛthak || 129|| evaṃ pṛthaksvabhāvaṃ pṛthagākāraṃ pṛthagvṛtti | jagaduccāvacamuccairekenaivātmanā calati || 130|| skandhadhṛtasiddhamannaṃ yāvannāśnāti mārgagastāvat | sparśabhayakṣutpīḍe tasminbhukte na te bhavataḥ || 131|| mānuṣamataṅgamahiṣaśvasūkarādiṣvanusyūtam | yaḥ paśyati jagadīśaṃ sa eva bhuṅkte'dvayānandam || 132|| <11> yadvatsūrye'bhyudite svavyavahāraṃ janaḥ kurute | taṃ na karoti vivasvānna kārayati tadvadātmāpi || 133|| lohe hutabhugvyāpte lohāntaratāḍyamāne'pi | tasyāntargatavahneḥ kiṃ syānnirghātajaṃ duḥkham || 134|| niṣṭhurakuṭhāraghātaiḥ kāṣṭhe sañchedyamāne'pi | antarvartī vahniḥ kiṃ ghātaiśchedyate tadvat || 135|| brūte śrutirapi bhūyo'naśnannanyo'bhicākaśītyādi || 136|| niśi veśmani pradīpe dīpyati caurastu vittamapaharati | īrayati vārayati vā taṃ dīpaḥ kiṃ tathātmāpi || 137|| gehānte daivavaśātkasmiṃścitsamudite vipanne vā | dīpastuṣyatyathavā khidyati kiṃ tadvadātmāpi || 138|| <12> ravicandravahnidīpapramukhāḥ svaparaprakāśāḥ syuḥ | yadyapi tathāpyamībhiḥ prakāśyate kvāpi naivātmā || 139|| cakṣurdvāraiva syātparātmanā bhānameteṣām | yadvā te'pi padārthā na jñāyante'tha kevalālokāt || 140|| tatrāpyakṣidvārā sahāyabhūto na cedātmā | no cetsatyāloke paśyatyandhaḥ kathaṃ nārthān || 141|| satyātmanyapi kiṃ no jñānaṃ taccendriyāntareṇa syāt | andhe dṛkpratibandhe karasambandhe padārthabhānaṃ hi || 142|| jānāti yena sarvaṃ kena ca taṃ vā vijānīyāt | ityupaniṣadāmuktirbadhyata ātmātmanā tasmāt || 143|| <13> yāvatkṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇārdhaṃ svarūpaparicintanaṃ kriyate | tāvaddakṣiṇakarṇe tvanāhataḥ śrūyate śabdaḥ || 144|| siddhyārambhasthiratāviśramaviśvāsabījaśuddhīnām | upalakṣaṇaṃ hi manasaḥ paramaṃ nādānusandhanam || 145|| bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhādyāhatanāde manaḥ kṣaṇaṃ ramate | kiṃ punaranāhate'sminmadhumadhure'khaṇḍite svacche || 146|| cittaṃ viṣayoparamādyathā yathā yāti naiścalyam | veṇoriva dīrghatarastathā tathā śrūyate nādaḥ || 147|| nādābhyantarvarti jyotiryadvartate hi ciram | tatra mano līnaṃ cenna punaḥ saṃsārabandhāya || 148|| paramānandānubhavātsuciraṃ nādānusandhānāt | śreṣṭhaścittalayo'yaṃ satsvanyalayeṣvanekeṣu || 149|| <14> saṃsāratāpataptaṃ nānāyonibhramātpariśrāntam | labdhvā paramānandaṃ na calati cetaḥ kadā kvāpi || 150|| advaitānandabharātkimidaṃ ko'haṃ ca kasyāham | iti mantharatāṃ yātaṃ yadā tadā mūrchitaṃ cetaḥ || 151|| cirataramātmānubhavādātmākāraṃ prajāyate cetaḥ | saridiva sāgarayātā samudrabhāvaṃ prayātyuccaiḥ || 152|| ātmanyanupraviṣṭaṃ cittaṃ nāpekṣate punarviṣayān | kṣīrāduddhṛtamājyaṃ yathā punaḥ kṣīratāṃ na yātīha || 153|| dṛṣṭau draṣṭari dṛśye yadanusyūtaṃ ca bhānamātraṃ syāt | tatropakṣīṇaṃ ceccittaṃ tanmūrchitaṃ bhavati || 154|| yāti svasaṃmukhatvaṃ dṛṅmātraṃ vā yadā tadā bhavati | dṛśyadraṣṭṛvibhedo hyasaṃmukhe'sminna tadbhavati || 155|| ekasmindṛṅmātre tredhā draṣṭrādikaṃ hi samudeti | trividhe tasmim̐llīne dṛṅmātraṃ śiṣyate paścāt || 156|| darpaṇataḥ prākpaścādasti mukhaṃ pratimukhaṃ tadābhāti | ādarśe'pi ca naṣṭe mukhamasti mukhe tathaivātmā || 157|| <15> mādhuryaṃ guḍapiṇḍe yattattasyāṃśake'ṇumātre'pi | evaṃ na pṛthagbhāvo guḍatvamadhuratvayorasti || 158|| athavā na bhinnabhāvaḥ karpūrāmodayorevam | ātmasvarūpamanasāṃ puṃsāṃ jagadātmatāṃ yāti || 159|| yadbhāvānubhavaḥ syānnidrādau jāgarasyānte | antaḥ sa cetsthiraḥ syāllabhate hi tadādvayānandam || 160|| atigambhīre'pāre jñānacidānandasāgare sphāre | karmasamīraṇataralā jīvataraṅgāvaliḥ sphurati || 161|| kharatarakaraiḥ pradīpte'bhyudite caitanyatigmāṃśau | sphurati mṛṣaiva samantādanekavidhajīvamṛgatṛṣṇā || 162|| antaradṛṣṭe yasmiñjagadidamārātparisphurati | dṛṣṭe yasminsakṛdapi vilīyate kvāpyasadrūpam || 163|| bāhyābhyantarapūrṇaḥ paramānandārṇave nimagno yaḥ | ciramāpluta iva kalaśo mahāhrade jahnutanayāyāḥ | 164|| pūrṇātpūrṇatare parātparatare'pyajñātapāre harau saṃvitsphārasudhārṇave virahite vīcītaraṅgādibhiḥ | bhāsvatkoṭivikāsitojjvaladigākāśaprakāśe pare svānandaikarase nimagnamanasāṃ na tvaṃ na cāhaṃ jagat || 165|| <16> citte sattvotpattau taṭidiva bodhodayo bhavati | tarhyeva sa sthiraḥ syādyadi cittaṃ śuddhimupayāti || 166|| śuddhyati hi nāntarātmā kṛṣṇapadāmbhojabhaktimṛte | vasanamiva kṣārodairbhaktyā prakṣālyate cetaḥ || 167|| yadvatsamalādarśe suciraṃ bhasmādinā śuddhe | pratiphalati vaktramuccaiḥ śuddhe citte tathā jñānam || 168|| jānantu tatra bījaṃ haribhaktyā jñānino ye syuḥ | mūrtaṃ caivāmūrtaṃ dve eva brahmaṇo rūpe || 169|| ityupaniṣattayorvā dvau bhakto bhagavadupadiṣṭau | kleśādakleśādvā muktiḥ syādetayormadhye || 170|| sthūlā sūkṣmā ceti dvedhā haribhaktiruddiṣṭā | prārambhe sthūlā syātsūkṣmā tasyāḥ sakāśācca || 171|| svāśramadharmācaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇapratimārcanotsavo nityam | vividhopacārakaraṇairharidāsaiḥ saṅgamaḥ śaśvat || 172|| kṛśṇakathāsaṃśravaṇe mahotsavaḥ satyavādaśca | parayuvatau draviṇe vā parāpavāde parāṅmukhatā || 173|| grāmyakathāsūdvegaḥ sutīrthagamaneṣu tātparyam | yadupatikathāviyoge vyarthaṃ gatamāyuriti cintā || 174|| evaṃ kurvati bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇakathānugrahotpannā | samudeti sūkṣmabhaktiryasyā harirantarāviśati || 175|| smṛtisatpurāṇavākyairyathāśrutāyāṃ harermūrtau | mānasapūjābhyāso vijananivāse'pi tātparyam || 176|| satyaṃ samastajantuṣu kṛṣṇasyāvasthiterjñānam | adroho bhūtagaṇe tatastu bhūtānukampā syāt || 177|| pramitayadṛcchālābhe santuṣṭirdāraputrādau | mamatāśūnyatvamato nirahaṅkāratvamakrodhaḥ || 178|| mṛdubhāṣitā prasādo nijanindāyāṃ stutau samatā | sukhaduḥkhaśītoṣṇadvandvasahiṣṇutvamāpado na bhayam || 179|| nidrāhāravihāreṣvanādaraḥ saṅgarāhityam | vacane cānavakāśaḥ kṛṣṇasmaraṇena śāśvatī śāntiḥ || 180|| kenāpi gīyamāne harigīte veṇunāde vā | ānandāvirbhāvo yugapatsyāddhṛṣṭasāttvikodrekaḥ || 181|| tasminnanubhavati manaḥ pragṛhyamāṇaṃ parātmasukham | sthiratāṃ yāte tasminyāti madonmattadantidaśām || 182|| januṣu bhagavadbhāvaṃ bhagavati bhūtāni paśyati kramaśaḥ | etādṛśī daśā cettadaiva haridasavaryaḥ syāt || 183|| <17> yamunātaṭanikaṭasthitavṛndāvanakānane mahāramye | kalpadrumatalabhūmau caraṇaṃ caraṇopari sthāpya || 184|| tiṣṭhantaṃ ghananīlaṃ svatejasā bhāsayantamiha viśvam | pītāmbaraparidhānaṃ candanakarpūraliptasarvāṅgam || 185|| ākarṇapūrṇanetraṃ kuṇḍalayugamaṇḍitaśravaṇam | mandasmitamukhakamalaṃ sukaustubhodāramaṇihāram || 185|| valayāṅgulīyakādyānujjvalayantaṃ svalaṅkārān | galavilulitavanamālaṃ svatejasāpāstakalikālam || 187|| guñjāravālikalitaṃ guñjāpuñjānvite śirasi | bhuñjānaṃ saha gopaiḥ kuñjāntaravartinaṃ hariṃ smarata || 188|| mandārapuṣpavāsitamandānilasevitaṃ parānandam | mandākinīyutapadaṃ namata mahānandadaṃ mahāpuruṣam || 189|| surabhīkṛtadigvalayaṃ surabhiśatairāvṛtaṃ sadā paritaḥ | surabhītikṣapaṇamahāsurabhīmaṃ yādavaṃ namata || 190|| kandarpakoṭisubhagaṃ vāñchitaphaladaṃ dayārṇavaṃ kṛṣṇam | tyaktvā kamanyaviṣayaṃ netrayugaṃ draṣṭumutsahate || 191|| puṇyatamāmatisurasāṃ mano'bhirāmāṃ hareḥ kathāṃ tyaktvā | śrotuṃ śravaṇadvandvaṃ grāmyaṃ kathamādaraṃ bhavati || 192|| daurbhāgyamindriyāṇāṃ kṛṣṇe viṣaye hi śāśvatike | kṣaṇikeṣu pāpakaraṇeṣvapi sajjante yadanyaviṣayeṣu || 193|| <18> śrutibhirmahāpurāṇaiḥ saguṇaguṇātītayoraikyam | yatproktaṃ gūḍhatayā tadahaṃ vakṣye'tiviśadārtham || 194|| bhūteṣvantaryāmī jñānamayaḥ saccidānandaḥ | prakṛteḥ paraḥ parātmā yadukulatilakaḥ sa evāyam || 195|| nanu saguṇo dṛśyatanustathaikadeśādhivāsaśca | sa kathaṃ bhavetparātmā prākṛtavadrāgaroṣayutaḥ || 196|| itare dṛśyapadārthā lakṣyante'nena cakṣuṣā sarve | bhagavānanayā dṛṣṭyā na lakṣyate jñānadṛggamyaḥ || 197|| yadviśvarūpadarśanasamaye pārthāya dattavānbhagavān | divyaṃ cakṣustasmādadṛśyatā yujyate nṛharau || 198|| sākṣādyathaikadeśe vartulamupalabhyate raverbimbam | viśvaṃ prakāśayati tatsarvaiḥ sarvatra dṛśyate yugapat || 199|| yadyapi sākāro'yaṃ tathaikadeśī vibhāti yadunāthaḥ | sarvagataḥ sarvātmā tathāpyayaṃ saccidānandaḥ || 200|| eko bhagavānreme yugapadgopīṣvanekāsu | athavā videhajanakaśrutadevabhūdevayorhariryugapat || 201|| athāvā kṛṣṇākārāṃ svacamūṃ duryodhano'paśyat | tasmādvyāpaka ātmā bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ || 202|| vakṣasi yadā jaghāna śrīvatsaḥ śrīpateḥ sa kiṃ dveṣyaḥ | bhaktānāmasurāṇāmanyeṣāṃ vā phalaṃ sadṛśam || 203|| tasmānna ko'pi śatrurno mitraṃ nāpyudāsīnaḥ | nṛhariḥ sanmārgasthaḥ saphalaḥ śākhīva yadunāthaḥ || 204|| lohaśalākanivahaiḥ sparśāśmani bhidyamāne'pi | svarṇatvameti lauhaṃ dveṣādapi vidviṣāṃ tathā prāptiḥ || 205|| nanvātmanaḥ sakāśādutpannā jīvasantatiśceyam | jagataḥ priyatara ātmā tatprakṛte naiva sambhavati || 206|| vatsāharaṇāvasare pṛthagvayorūpavāsanābhūṣān | harirajamohaṃ kartuṃ savatsagopānvinirmame svasmāt || 207|| agneryathā sphuliṅgāḥ kṣudrāstu vyuccarantīti | śrutyarthaṃ darśayituṃ svatanoratanotsa jīvasandoham || 208|| yamunātīranikuñje kadācidapi vatsakāṃśca cārayati | kṛṣṇe tathāryagopeṣu ca varagoṣṭheṣu cārayatsvārāt || 209|| vatsaṃ nirīkṣya dūrādgāvaḥ snehena sambhrāntāḥ | tadabhimukhaṃ dhāvantyaḥ prayayurgopaiśca durvārāḥ || 210|| prasravabhareṇa bhūyaḥ srutastanāḥ prāpya pūrvavadvatsān | pṛthurasanayā lihantyastarṇakavatyaḥ prapāyayanpramudā || 211|| gopa api nijabālāñjagṛhurmūrdhānamāghrāya | itthamalaukikalābhasteṣāṃ tatra kṣaṇaṃ vavṛdhe || 212|| gopā vatsāścānyā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇātmakā hyabhavan | tenātmanaḥ priyatvaṃ darśitameteṣu kṛṣṇena || 213|| preyaḥ putrādvittātpreyo'nyasmācca sarvasmāt | antarataraṃ yadātmetyupaniṣadaḥ satyatābhihitā || 214|| nanvuccāvacabhūteṣvātmā sama eva vartate'tha hariḥ | duryodhane'rjune vā taratamabhāvaṃ kathaṃ nu gatavānsaḥ || 215|| badhirāndhapaṅgumūkā dīrghāḥ kharvāḥ sarūpāśca | sarve vidhinā dṛṣṭāḥ savatsagopāścaturbhujāstena || 216|| bhūtasamatvaṃ nṛhareḥ samo hi maśakena nāgena | lokaiḥ samastribhirvetyupaniṣadā bhāṣitaḥ sākṣāt || 217|| ātmā tāvadabhoktā tathaiva nanu vāsudevaścet | nānākaitavayatnaiḥ pararamaṇībhiḥ kathaṃ ramate || 218|| sundaramabhinavarūpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimohitā gopyaḥ | tamabhilaṣantyo manasā kāmādvirahavyathāṃ prāpuḥ || 219|| gacchantyastiṣṭhantyo gṛhakṛtyaparāśca bhuñjānāḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ vinānyaviṣayaṃ samakṣamapi jātu nāvindan || 220|| duḥsahavirahabhrāntyā svapatīndadṛśustarūnnarāṃśca paśūn | harirayamiti suprītāḥ sarabhasamāliṅgayāñcakruḥ || 221|| kā'pi ca kṛṣṇāyantī kasyāścitpūtanāyantyāḥ | apibatstanamiti sākṣādvyāso nārāyaṇaḥ prāha || 222|| tasmānnijanijadayitānkṛṣṇākārānvṛjastriyo vīkṣya | svaparanṛpatipatnīnāmantaryāmī hariḥ sākṣāt || 223|| paramārthato vicāre guḍatanmadhuratvadṛṣṭāntāt | naśvaramapi naradehaṃ paramātmākāratāṃ yāti || 224|| kiṃ punaranantaśakterlīlāvapurīśvarasyeha | karmāṇyalaukikāni svamāyayā vidadhato nṛhareḥ || 225|| mṛdbhakṣaṇena kupiatāṃ vikasitavadanāṃ svamātaraṃ vaktre | viśvamadarśayadakhilaṃ kiṃ punaratha viśvarūpo'sau || 226|| <19> viṣaviṣamastanayugalaṃ pāyayituṃ pūtanā gṛhaṃ prāptā | tasyāḥ pṛthubhāgyāyā āsītkṛṣṇārpaṇo dehaḥ || 227|| anayatpṛthutaraśakaṭaṃ nijanikaṭaṃ vā kṛtāparādhamapi | kaṇṭhāśleṣaviśeṣādavadhīdbālye'suraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ || 228|| yamalārjunau tarū unmūlyolūkhalagataściraṃ khinnau | riṅgannaṅgaṇabhūmau svamālayaṃ prāpayannṛhariḥ || 229|| nityaṃ tridaśadveṣī yena ca mṛtyorvaśīkṛtaḥ keśī | kākaḥ ko'pi varāko bako'pyaśokaṃ gato lokam || 230|| gogopīgopānāṃ nikaramahi pīḍayantamativegāt | anaghamaghāsuramakarotpṛthutaramurageśvaraṃ bhagavān || 231|| pītvāraṇyahutāśanamasahyatattejaso hetoḥ | dagdhānmugdhānakhilāñjugopa gopānkṛpāsindhuḥ || 232|| pātu gokulamākulamaśanitaṭidvarṣaṇaiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ | asahāyaekahaste govardhanamuddadhāroccaiḥ || 233|| vāsolobhākalitaṃ dhāvadrajakaṃ śilātalairhatvā | vismṛtya tadaparādhaṃ vikuṇṭhavāso'rpitastasmai || 234|| tredhā vakraśarīrāmatilamboṣṭhīṃ skhaladvapurvacanāt | srakcandanaparitoṣātkubjāmṛjvānanāmakarot || 235|| nihataḥ papāta hariṇā haricaraṇāgreṇa kuvalayāpīḍaḥ | tuṅgonmattamataṅgaḥ pataṅgavaddīpakasyāgre || 236|| yuddhamiṣātsaha raṅge śrīraṅgenāṅgasaṅgamaṃ prāpya | musśṭikacāṇūrākhyau yayaturniḥśreyasaṃ sapadi || 237|| dehakṛtādaparādhādvaikuṇṭhotkaṇṭhitāntarātmānam | yaduvarakulāvataṃsaḥ kaṃsaṃ vidhvaṃsayāmāsa || 238|| harisandarśanayogātpṛthuraṇatīrthe nimajjate tasmai | bhagavānnu pradadādyaḥ sadyaścaidyāya sāyujyam || 239|| mīnādibhiravatārairnihatāḥ suravidviṣo bahavaḥ | nītāste nijarūpaṃ tatra ca mokṣasya kā vārtā || 240|| ye yadunandananihatāste tu na bhūyaḥ punarbhavaṃ prāpuḥ | tasmādavatārāṇāmantaryāmī pravartakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ || 241|| brahmāṇḍāni bahūni paṅkajabhavānpratyaṇḍamatyadbhutān gopānvatsayutānadarśayadajaṃ viṣṇūnaśeṣāṃśca yaḥ | śambhuryaccaraṇodakaṃ svaśirasā dhatte ca mūrtitrayāt kṛṣṇo vai pṛthagasti ko'pyavikṛtaḥ saccinmayo nīlimā || 242|| kṛpāpātraṃ yasya tripuraripurambhojavasatiḥ sutā jahnoḥ pūtā caraṇanakhanirṇejanajalam | pradānaṃ vā yasya tribhuvanapatitvaṃ vibhurapi nidānaṃ so'smākaṃ jayati kuladevo yadupatiḥ || 243|| māyāhaste'rpayitvā bharaṇakṛtikṛte mohamūlodbhavaṃ māṃ mātaḥ kṛṣṇābhidhāne cirasamayamudāsīnabhāvaṃ gatāsi | kāruṇyaikādhivāse sakṛdapi vadanaṃ nekṣase tvaṃ madīyaṃ tatsarvajñe na kartuṃ prabhavasi bhavatī kiṃ nu mūlasya śāntim || 244|| udāsīnaḥ stabdhaḥ satatamaguṇaḥ saṅgarahito bhavāṃstātaḥ kātaḥ paramiha bhavejjīvanagatiḥ | akasmādasmākaṃ yadi na kurute snehamatha tat vasasva svīyāntarvimalajaṭhare'sminpunarapi || 245|| lokādhīśe tvayīśe kimiti bhavabhavā vedanā svāśritānāṃ saṅkocaḥ paṅkajānāṃ kimiha samudite maṇḍale caṇḍaraśmeḥ | bhogaḥ pūrvārjitānāṃ bhavati bhuvi nṛṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ cedavaśyaṃ tanme dṛṣṭairnṛpuṣṭairnanu danujanṛpairūrjitaṃ nirjitaṃ te || 246|| nityānandasudhānidheradhigataḥ sannīlameghaḥ satāmautkaṇṭhyaprabalaprabhañjanabharairākarṣito varṣati | vijñānāmṛtamadbhutaṃ nijavaco dhārābhirārādidaṃ cetaścātaka cenna vāñchatimṛṣākrānto'si supto'si kim || 247|| cetaścañcalatāṃ vihāya purataḥ sandhāya koṭidvayaṃ tatraikatra nidhehi sarvaviṣayānanyatra ca śrīpatim | viśrāntirhitamapyaho kva nu tvayormadhye tadālocyatāṃ yuktyā vānubhavena yatra paramānandaśca tatsevyatām || 248|| putrānpautramathastriyo'nyayuvatīrvittanyatho'nyaddhanaṃ bhojyādiṣvapi tāratamyavaśato nālaṃ samutkaṇṭhayā | naitādṛgyadunāyake samudite cetasyanante vibhau sāndrānandasudhārṇave viharati svairaṃ yato nirbhayam || 249|| kāmyopāsanayārthayantyanudinaṃ kiñcitphalaṃ sepsitaṃ kiñcitsvargamathāpavargamaparairyogādiyajñādibhiḥ | asmākaṃ yadunandanāṅghriyugaladhyānāvadhānārthināṃ kiṃ lokena damena kiṃ nṛpatinā svargāpavargaiśca kim || 250|| āśritamātraṃ puruṣaṃ svābhimukhaṃ karṣati śrīśaḥ | lohamapi cumbakāśmā saṃmukhamātraṃ jaḍaṃ yadvat || 251|| ayamuttamo'yamadhamo jātyā rūpeṇa sampadā vayasā | ślāghyo'ślāghyo vetthaṃ na vetti bhagavānanugrahāvasare || 252|| antaḥsthabhāvabhoktā tato'ntarātmā mahāmeghaḥ | khadiraścampaka iva vā pravarṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vicārayati || 253|| yadyapi sarvatra samastathāpi nṛharistathāpyete | bhaktāḥ paramānande ramanti sadayāvalokena || 254|| sutarāmananyaśaraṇāḥ kṣīrādyāhāramantarā yadvat | kevalayā snehadṛśā kacchapatanayāḥ prajīvanti || 255|| yadyapi gaganaṃ śūnyaṃ tathāpi jaladāmṛtāṃśrūpeṇa | cātakacakoranāmnordṛḍhabhāvātpūrayatyāśām || 256|| tadvadrajatāṃ puṃsāṃ dṛgvāṅmanasāmagocaro'pi hariḥ | kṛpayā phalatyakasmātsatyānandāmṛtena vipulena || 257|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau prabodhasudhākaraḥ samāptaḥ ||
